lead: The options are quantity words (each, every, all, most, few, little, another) or one noun in singular and plural. The noun after the blank decides: singular, plural, or uncountable.
選項是數量詞（each、every、all、most、few、little、another），或同一個名詞的單數和複數。由空格後面的名詞決定：單數、複數，還是不可數。
steps: Find the noun after the blank and decide: singular countable, plural, or uncountable.
找出空格後面的名詞，判斷它是單數可數、複數，還是不可數。
Check for the, these or a possessive after the quantity word. It changes the pattern: most employees, most of the employees.
看數量詞後面有沒有 the、these 或所有格。這會改變句型：most employees、most of the employees。
Check the verb: each and uncountable nouns take a singular verb.
再看動詞：each 和不可數名詞用單數動詞。

head: Words for a singular noun
接單數名詞的數量詞
body: each, every, another, either, neither are followed by a singular countable noun and take a singular verb.
each、every、another、either、neither 後面接單數可數名詞，動詞用單數。
ex: Each participant will receive a certificate.
每位參加者都會獲得證書。
Another delivery is due this afternoon.
今天下午還有一批貨要送到。

head: Words for plural nouns
接複數名詞的數量詞
body: many, several, few, a few, both, a number of, a variety of, a wide range of are followed by a plural noun.
many、several、few、a few、both、a number of、a variety of、a wide range of 後面接複數名詞。
ex: Several clients have asked about the new service.
有好幾位客戶問過這項新服務。
The store sells a wide variety of office supplies.
這家店販售各式各樣的辦公用品。

head: Words for uncountable nouns
接不可數名詞的數量詞
body: much, little, a little, a great deal of, an amount of go with uncountable nouns. Use fewer with plural nouns and less with uncountable ones.
much、little、a little、a great deal of、an amount of 搭配不可數名詞。fewer 接複數名詞，less 接不可數名詞。
ex: There is little time left before the deadline.
離截止時間已經沒剩多少了。
A great deal of work remains on the new website.
新網站還有許多工作要做。
The new system produces fewer errors and takes less time.
新系統出的錯比較少，也比較省時間。

head: few and a few
few 和 a few
body: few means 'almost none' and sounds negative. a few means 'some'. little and a little work the same way with uncountable nouns.
few 表示「幾乎沒有」，語氣偏否定。a few 表示「有一些」。little 和 a little 也一樣，但接不可數名詞。
ex: Few customers complained, so the launch was a success.
幾乎沒有顧客抱怨，所以這次上市很成功。
We have a little time to review the contract before the call.
通話之前，我們還有一點時間審閱合約。

head: most, most of, almost all
most、most of、almost all 的分別
body: most + noun means most in general. most of the + noun means most of a specific group. almost is an adverb: it needs all before a noun.
most + 名詞是泛指的大部分。most of the + 名詞是某個特定群體中的大部分。almost 是副詞，接名詞前要加 all。
ex: Most employees prefer flexible working hours.
大部分員工偏好彈性工時。
Most of the employees in the sales department work remotely.
業務部的大部分員工都遠距工作。
Almost all employees attended the annual meeting.
幾乎所有員工都出席了年會。

head: Uncountable nouns that look countable
看起來可數的不可數名詞
body: equipment, information, furniture, luggage, advice, feedback, merchandise, machinery, clothing, access have no plural form and no a. Their verbs are singular.
equipment、information、furniture、luggage、advice、feedback、merchandise、machinery、clothing、access 沒有複數形，前面不加 a，動詞用單數。
ex: All of the new equipment has been installed.
所有新設備都已經安裝好了。
We received useful feedback from customers.
我們從顧客那裡得到了有用的意見。

head: the number of and a number of
the number of 和 a number of
body: the number of + plural noun takes a singular verb, because the subject is the number. a number of means 'several' and takes a plural verb. the amount of goes with uncountable nouns.
the number of + 複數名詞，動詞用單數，因為主詞是「數量」。a number of 表示「幾個」，動詞用複數。the amount of 接不可數名詞。
ex: The number of applicants has doubled this year.
今年的應徵人數增加了一倍。
A number of clients have requested a refund.
有幾位客戶要求退款。
The amount of paperwork has decreased.
文書作業的量減少了。

pairs.right: We received useful feedback from customers.
pairs.wrong: We received useful feedbacks from customers.
why: feedback is uncountable and has no plural form.
feedback 是不可數名詞，沒有複數形。
almost is an adverb and cannot stand directly before a noun. Add all.
almost 是副詞，不能直接接名詞，要加 all。
most of needs the, these or a possessive before the noun.
most of 後面的名詞前要有 the、these 或所有格。

traps: every takes a singular noun, but with a number it takes a plural noun to show frequency: every three months.
every 後面接單數名詞，但加數字時接複數名詞表示頻率：every three months。
each of + plural noun still takes a singular verb: Each of the managers has a key.
each of 加複數名詞，動詞仍用單數：Each of the managers has a key。
much and many follow the noun type, not the meaning. many goes with items; much goes with equipment.
much 和 many 看名詞的類型，不看意思。many 配 items；much 配 equipment。
